summary.content:
Today's selection covers 90 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 61 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Lords call for AI 'kill switch' powers in UK
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: US charges Russian for infecting 80,000 freelancers with malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 66 articles published in the last 24 hours
